Questions and answers

Frequently asked questions

Short answers about the missed-call assistant, in plain terms.

What does Lobsang Solutions do for local businesses?

Lobsang Solutions sets up a missed-call assistant for local businesses in Austin, Travis County and beyond. When you cannot pick up, the assistant answers in your business name, texts the caller back, and books the job on your calendar.

Who is the missed-call assistant for?

Shops and crews who lose work when the phone rings while they are on a job. That includes plumbers, HVAC, electrical, and roofing companies, and other local businesses that book work by phone.

How does the missed-call assistant work?

A customer calls while you are busy, after hours, or on another job. Your assistant answers in your business name and texts the caller back. The appointment is booked straight onto your calendar, and you see the booking.

How fast does the assistant text a caller back?

In under a minute. A missed call turns into a text conversation right away, before the caller moves on to the next shop.

How does pricing work?

It starts with a free missed-call audit. Pricing depends on your call volume and what you need the assistant to do. We state the price in plain terms before any work starts, and the audit itself is free.

How do I get started?

Book a free missed-call audit or call +1 (737) 271-0776. The audit is a short call about how your calls are handled today and where jobs are slipping away.

What do callers hear when the assistant answers?

They hear your business name. You name your assistant, and callers deal with your shop, not a call center.

Does the assistant answer after hours?

Yes. It covers calls that come in while you are busy, on another job, or closed for the day.

Do I need to change my phone number?

No. The assistant works with the business number you already use.

What happens after a job is booked?

The appointment sits on your calendar and you can see it right away. You show up for the job. That is it.

Do you build websites for local businesses?

Yes. We build clean, professional websites for local businesses. The site says what you do, where you work, and how to reach you, with tap-to-call and online booking built in.

I already have a website. Can you fix it or rebuild it?

Yes. We can rebuild a site that is out of date, or build a new one. We talk through what you have now on the first call and say plainly what we would change.

How much does a website cost?

It depends on the size of the site and what it needs to do. We quote the full price before any work starts.

What is a CRM, in plain terms?

It is one place where your customer details, calls, texts, and bookings are kept, so nothing is lost in a notebook or a phone. When a call comes in, a text goes out, or a job is booked, it is recorded there.

How do the website, the CRM, and the assistant fit together?

The website brings people to you and lets them call or book. The assistant answers the calls you miss and books the job. The CRM keeps the record of every customer, call, text, and booking in one place.

How long does setup take?

It depends on what you need set up. We go over the timing on the audit call, before any work starts.

Which areas do you serve?

Austin, Travis County and beyond. If you are outside that area, call us and ask.

What kinds of businesses do you work with?

Local businesses that book work by phone. Home services are the most common: plumbing, HVAC, electrical, and roofing. Other local shops and crews are welcome too.

How do I contact Lobsang Solutions?

Call +1 (737) 271-0776, email contact@lobsangsolutions.com, or book a call on this site. The office is at 1005 Congress Avenue, Suite 925, Austin, TX.

Questions and answers

Frequently asked questions

Short answers about the staffing service, in plain terms.

What does Lobsang Solutions do for government and enterprise teams?

Lobsang Solutions provides IT staffing for government and enterprise teams. We supply engineers and developers for roles a team needs filled, across Texas and nationwide.

What roles does Lobsang Solutions staff?

Architects and engineers across cloud, AI, forward-deployed and production roles, at senior, manager and executive levels, along with web developers and front-end developers.

How does the staffing process work?

You tell us the role, the team it joins, and the timeline on a short call. We say plainly whether we are the right fit. If we are, we put forward people who match the role.

Where does Lobsang Solutions provide staffing?

Across the entire state of Texas and nationwide. The company is based in Austin, Texas, and out-of-state clients are welcome.

How does pricing work?

Pricing depends on the role, the level of experience needed, and how long you need the person. We discuss the rate for a role on the first call, before any placement work starts.

How do we get started?

Book a call, call +1 (737) 271-0776, or email contact@lobsangsolutions.com. The first step is a short conversation about the role you need filled.

What types of staffing do you offer?

Staff augmentation. The people we supply join your team and work under your direction, for the length of the engagement you need. The shape of the engagement is agreed on the first call, before any work starts.

How are candidates vetted?

People who have done the work do the vetting. Our team has decades of software contracting experience, so candidates are checked against the actual role: the skills it needs, the level it needs, and the work the team is doing.

How fast can you present candidates?

It depends on the role and how specialized it is. Common roles move faster than rare ones. We give you a straight timeline on the first call, based on the role in front of us.

Can you fill senior and specialized roles?

Yes. We supply architects and engineers across cloud, AI, forward-deployed and production roles, at senior, manager and executive levels, as well as web and front-end developers.

Do you supply web and front-end developers, or only engineers?

Both. We supply web developers and front-end developers alongside architects and engineers.

How long can an engagement last?

It depends on the project and the team. Length is set out and agreed before the engagement starts, and it can be revisited as the work changes.

Can the person work remotely, on site, or hybrid?

That is set by the role and the team. Tell us how your team works on the first call, and we match candidates to it.

Do you work with government agencies?

Yes. We staff government and enterprise teams. Our team has delivered work inside the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, among other large organizations.

What experience do you have with large organizations?

Our team has delivered work for teams at Walmart Labs, Florida Blue, Neiman Marcus, Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, and Kaiser Permanente, and others beyond those teams.

Do you only staff in Texas?

No. We are based in Austin and staff across the entire state of Texas and nationwide. Out-of-state clients are welcome.

What do you need from us to start a search?

The role, the skills it needs, the team it joins, and the timeline. That is enough for the first call.

Who do we talk to when we work with you?

People who have done the work themselves. There is no sales rep reading a script between you and the staffing decision.

What happens if a placement is not a good fit?

Tell us early. We will talk it through with you and work on a better match for the role.

How is Lobsang Solutions different from a large staffing agency?

We are a small, Austin-based company, and the staffing is done by people with decades of contracting experience in the same kinds of roles. You deal with us directly, and we say plainly whether we are the right fit for a role.
